Delhi through seven cities

A three-day private journey through Delhi's historic cities

Made for your group

  • Your day and start time, weekends and special days included
  • Any group size, from one person to a whole class
  • Your pace and your language: English, Hindi or both

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and starting point. We prepare a day-by-day itinerary and a quotation, and revise both until they suit you. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

Delhi is a sequence of cities built beside one another over a thousand years. This journey reads them in order, with no more than two major monuments a day.

Everything is arranged privately for you: dates, pace, hotels, transport and the language you are guided in. You receive a day-by-day itinerary and an itemised quotation before you commit.

What it covers

  • The Qutb complex
  • Mehrauli and Humayun's Tomb
  • Shahjahanabad

Day by day

  1. Day 1: The Qutb complex

    Arrival, rest, and an unhurried reading of the Qutb complex.

  2. Day 2: Mehrauli and Humayun's Tomb

    Mehrauli Archaeological Park in the morning, Humayun's Tomb in the afternoon, with lunch between.

  3. Day 3: Shahjahanabad

    Old Delhi and the Red Fort, then a flexible departure.

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Explain how Delhi grew as a sequence of cities built beside one another.
  • Read the Qutb complex, Mehrauli Archaeological Park and Humayun's Tomb in historical order.
  • Place Old Delhi and the Red Fort within the sequence of Delhi's historic cities.

You take away

Your own notes and observations from each site.
